neighbours.label: The later pieces of spasm words ('ms' in spasms, 'asm' in spasm, 'astic' in spastic, 'mod' in spasmodic, Russian 'мы' in спазмы); other symptom words stay quiet, though 'cramps' may leak.
fire: Her doctor treated the painful back spasms.
He woke with a sudden leg spasm.
Stress can bring on esophageal spasms.
The child has spastic muscles in both legs.
The engine gave a spasmodic jerk and stopped.
У него начались сильные спазмы желудка.
Coughing fits and throat spasms kept him up.
Hot baths ease a neck spasm.
quiet: Her doctor treated the painful back injury.
He woke with a sudden leg cramp.
Stress can bring on stomach ulcers.
The child has elastic bands on both legs.
The engine gave a loud bang and stopped.
У него начались сильные боли желудка.
Coughing fits and throat pain kept him up.
Hot baths ease a neck strain.

notes: Probes: 0.52-1.04. 'cramps' 0.27 on 'amps'; others 0.01 or lower. 'ms' is the commonest of the top 32; 'ag' and '2' are there too, not covered.
